description: Every completed ARKS K-subspace compression run, one record per (model, coefficient precision, eval corpus). Each record carries the 49 columns the benchmark writes, plus 4 identity fields recovered from the run directory path.

experiment.method: ARKS -- K-subspaces weight compression with first-order adaptive rank allocation
experiment.calibration_shape: 4 samples x 256 tokens, first 1024 tokens of the joined split, not shuffled

eval_corpora.wikitext2: test split, rows joined with '\n\n', full split
eval_corpora.ptb: test split, rows stripped and joined with ' ', full split
eval_corpora.c4: validation split, first 1100 rows joined with ' ', first 256 segments of 2048 tokens

identity_fields.name: model_tag
identity_fields.description: Run directory name, e.g. 'opt-66b'. Short form of the `model` column.

identity_fields.name: eval_corpus
identity_fields.description: Evaluation corpus this row's perplexity was measured on: wikitext2 | ptb | c4. NOT present in the CSV -- recovered from the ppl/<corpus>/ path segment.

identity_fields.name: precision
identity_fields.description: Coefficient precision: 'fp16' (16-bit) or 'int8' (8-bit). Recovered from the adaptive_baseline_<precision>/ path segment; matches the `coefficient_bits` column.

identity_fields.name: seed
identity_fields.description: Compression/allocation seed. 0 for every run here.

columns.name: model
columns.description: Hugging Face model id, e.g. 'facebook/opt-66b'.

columns.name: target
columns.description: Which weights were compressed. 'all' in every run here.

columns.name: codebook_calibration
columns.description: Codebook fine-tuning mode. 'none' in every run -- no gradient training of the basis was performed, so these results are training-free.

columns.name: matrix_types
columns.description: Comma-separated linear-layer suffixes that were compressed (q/k/v/o_proj, MLP projections).

columns.name: selected_layers
columns.description: Comma-separated decoder layer indices that were compressed.

columns.name: rank
columns.description: Base rank r applied to every tile before the allocator promotes any.

columns.name: rank_overrides
columns.description: JSON object mapping 'layer_NN_<suffix>' -> promoted rank, for the matrices the first-order allocator selected to upgrade. Empty object means nothing was promoted.

columns.name: tile_overrides
columns.description: JSON object of per-matrix tile-shape overrides. '{}' in every run here.

columns.name: effective_ranks
columns.description: The distinct ranks actually present after allocation, e.g. '4,6'.

columns.name: coefficient_bits
columns.description: Bits per stored coefficient: 16 for fp16 runs, 8 for int8 runs.

columns.name: coefficient_encoding
columns.description: Coefficient encoding scheme. 'scalar' in every run here.

columns.name: coefficient_codebook_size
columns.description: VQ codebook size; empty under scalar encoding.

columns.name: coefficient_vq_stages
columns.description: VQ stage count; empty under scalar encoding.

columns.name: vq_stage_overrides
columns.description: Per-matrix VQ stage overrides. '{}' in every run here.

columns.name: effective_vq_stages
columns.description: Distinct VQ stage counts present. '1' in every run here.

columns.name: sparsity
columns.description: The --sparsity argument as passed to the benchmark. 1.0 in every run here (no coefficient sparsification on top of the subspace coding).

columns.name: k
columns.description: Number of shared subspace basis vectors (K). 512 in every run here.

columns.name: C
columns.description: Tile height c.

columns.name: tile_width
columns.description: Tile width t.

columns.name: tile_shape
columns.description: Tile shape as 'CxT', e.g. '8x1'.

columns.name: effective_tile_heights
columns.description: Distinct tile heights present after any overrides.

columns.name: layers_evaluated
columns.description: Number of decoder layers compressed.

columns.name: matrices_evaluated
columns.description: Number of weight matrices compressed.

columns.name: ppl
columns.description: Perplexity of the ARKS-compressed model on `eval_corpus`.

columns.name: ppl_tokens
columns.description: Token count the compressed-model perplexity was averaged over.

columns.name: dense_ppl
columns.description: Perplexity of the uncompressed model on the same corpus and tokenization. The baseline every degradation figure is relative to.

columns.name: dense_ppl_tokens
columns.description: Token count for the dense baseline. Equals ppl_tokens.

columns.name: ppl_increase
columns.description: ppl - dense_ppl, in absolute perplexity units.

columns.name: ppl_increase_percent
columns.description: 100 * (ppl / dense_ppl - 1).

columns.name: dense_inference_seconds
columns.description: Wall-clock of the dense baseline forward pass.

columns.name: mse_all_weights
columns.description: Mean squared reconstruction error over every compressed weight element: sum((W - W_hat)^2) / count.

columns.name: mse_nonzero_weights
columns.description: Same, restricted to elements that are nonzero in the original weight.

columns.name: relative_frobenius_error
columns.description: ||W - W_hat||_F / ||W||_F, aggregated over all compressed matrices.

columns.name: evaluated_weights
columns.description: Number of weight elements compressed and scored.

columns.name: artifact_storage_mb
columns.description: On-disk size of the compressed artifacts: shared bases + per-tile coefficients + subspace ids.

columns.name: artifact_bits_per_compressed_parameter
columns.description: 8 * artifact_bytes / compressed_parameter_count. Counts only the compressed matrices.

columns.name: static_parameter_storage_mb
columns.description: Size of the parameters left untouched (embeddings, layer norms, lm_head) at their original precision.

columns.name: total_model_storage_mb
columns.description: artifact_storage_mb + static_parameter_storage_mb.

columns.name: total_model_bits_per_parameter
columns.description: 8 * (artifact_bytes + static_bytes) / total_parameter_count. The parameter retention ratio is rho = this / 16; compression reduction is 1 - rho.

columns.name: model_load_seconds
columns.description: Loading the base model weights.

columns.name: artifact_load_seconds
columns.description: Loading the compressed artifacts from disk.

columns.name: reconstruction_seconds
columns.description: Rebuilding dense weights from the artifacts. Single-threaded NumPy; on the 66B/70B models this is ~98% of the stage and dwarfs the GPU forward pass.

columns.name: metric_seconds
columns.description: Computing the MSE / Frobenius reconstruction metrics.

columns.name: inference_seconds
columns.description: GPU forward pass for the perplexity evaluation only.

columns.name: total_seconds
columns.description: Total wall-clock for the inference stage.

columns.name: peak_cpu_rss_mb
columns.description: Peak host resident set size of the process, absolute.

columns.name: peak_cpu_rss_increase_mb
columns.description: Peak host RSS measured as an increase over process start.

columns.name: peak_cuda_allocated_mb
columns.description: Peak VRAM actually allocated by PyTorch tensors.

columns.name: peak_cuda_reserved_mb
columns.description: Peak VRAM reserved from the driver by the caching allocator. Always >= allocated; this is the number to use when asking whether a model fits on a GPU.

caveats: The 49 CSV columns carry no eval-corpus or precision field; both are recovered from the directory path and exposed here as `eval_corpus` and `precision`. Never join these rows without them -- a model has 6 rows (3 corpora x 2 precisions) that are otherwise identical in their configuration columns.

codebook_calibration is 'none' everywhere: no weights and no codebooks were trained. The rank allocator does run a backward pass, but only to read dL/dW for its importance score -- there is no optimizer and no parameter update. These are one-shot, post-training results.

Calibration always used wikitext2 train (the first 4 x 256 = 1024 tokens of the joined split, deterministically, no shuffling), for every model, corpus and precision. wikitext2 eval is therefore in-domain with calibration; PTB and C4 are held out.
peak_cuda_reserved_mb >= peak_cuda_allocated_mb. Use reserved for capacity questions.
rho (parameter retention) = total_model_bits_per_parameter / 16. Compression reduction is 1 - rho. The two are easy to confuse; state which one a figure plots.

opt-66b and Llama-3.1-70B ran their inference layer-wise (one decoder layer resident on the GPU at a time) because a reconstructed dense copy does not fit in 80 GB. Verified bitwise identical to the all-on-GPU path on opt-125m, so the PPL numbers are directly comparable.
Llama-3.1-70B on wikitext2 is the one outlier in the set: +42.95% versus +5.65% on PTB and +12.53% on C4 for the same model. Unexplained; do not average it away without noting it.
